Per-pixel pop measurement of cleave_impact (scale-out round 3, plan Amendment 6).

Method: the lab's 40 ms sequence frames of the contact-sheet program (lavapipe, debug battle_capture, bright ground,
default zoom, 1280x720), each cropped to the middle half (640x360 at 320,180: the cell the sheet shows). For each
pair of consecutive frames, the number of pixels whose colour differs by more than 3 % (ImageMagick
`compare -fuzz 3% -metric AE`). Steps 0 to 3 are the impact (flash, front racing out); a pop is a step after the
impact larger than its neighbours.
